bibl.title: Il saluto conclusivo nelle lettere degli alti funzionari provinciali: ἐρρῶσθαι ... βούλομαι
bibl.seg: Roberto Mascellari, Il saluto conclusivo nelle lettere degli alti funzionari provinciali: ἐρρῶσθαι… βούλομαι.
bibl.note: By re-examining the letters of prefects and other officials, proposes to consider ἐρρῶσθαι… βούλομαι as the standard epistolary farewell formula in Greek used by prefects from the early 2nd century CE to the mid-3rd century CE, while in the same period ἐρρῶσθαι… εὔχομαι was avoided by prefects and commonly used by subordinate officials.
